TradingView Indicators

Custom Pine Script indicators for TradingView, with guides for setup and usage.

Indicator Guides

  • MA High/Low

    Dynamic channel from moving averages of highs and lows with trend analysis.

  • Opening Range Breakout with Opportunity Window

    Intraday ORB system for futures with range quality, VWAP, and target projection.

  • Price/Volume Delta Candles

    Divergence detection between price action and volume delta.

  • Up/Down Volume Ratio

    Momentum and sentiment tool comparing buying vs. selling volume pressure.

  • Volatility Expansion Index

    Market regime filter comparing short-term and long-term volatility.

Strategies

  • Short Put

    Options strategy documentation.

Source code and additional indicators are on GitHub.

These indicators are for educational and analysis purposes only.
